## Session topics & takeaways

This session covers:

1. Make-or-buy analysis; build vs buy vs subscribe for data platforms
2. FP, T&M, CR (cost-plus); risk allocation by contract type
3. RFP anatomy, proposal evaluation, SLA & exit clauses; outsourcing pitfalls
